contracts.scope: Browser supplies only registered projectId and relative paths; no native root/cwd. Bounded directory browser and direct path navigation. Unsupported entries, binary/non-UTF8 files, >512 KiB text and truncated directory/ref results are explicit.
contracts.editor: File drafts bind projectId/path/baseRevision. Existing file writes carry captured SHA-256 expectedRevision; creation uses null. A conflicting new version preserves original text plus draft, requires explicit compare/rebase, and a separate save. UTF-8 512 KiB limit and bounded 10-draft/8 MiB session storage.
contracts.delivery: Api.beginMutation exposes durable identity and synchronous prepare callback before dispatch. Pending file intent must persist before network write. Storage failure stops dispatch. Unknown saves retain submitted revision/text and query only original global operation/read; accepted proof is followed by project/path readback. New edits during save are preserved. Unmount/navigation preserves pending intent and never causes duplicate write.
contracts.recovery: No native helper journal is promoted to accepted in UI. Global receipt witness recovery remains gateway responsibility. Missing or unknown receipt does not grant retry permission. Accepted-but-different readback preserves conflict draft. Confirmed not_sent permits deliberate later save.
contracts.operations: mkdir/copy/remove use durable mutations. Copy captures source revision and destination must not exist. Delete requires exact relative-path confirmation, confirm:true and recursive:false. No unsupported restore or recursive deletion control.
contracts.git: Read-only status and staged/unstaged diff; refs are visible metadata and explicit review base targets. No checkout, commit, Git index mutation or arbitrary argv. AGENTS.md follows ordinary file read/conflict-safe write.
contracts.ownership: Late project/path reads cannot take over newer navigation. File draft identity includes project. Workspace remains mounted to retain drafts on auth loss; root modal auth-loss cleanup remains in effect.
